Community Event

Flourish 2027

Date: Mar 11, 2027

Time: 6 p.m. - 9 p.m.

Location: VCC Broadway Campus | 1120 E. 7th Ave, Vancouver




Experience an unforgettable evening of food, wine, and community.

General Admission: 7 – 9 p.m.

Explore three floors of culinary creations and beverages from notable VCC alumni chefs and local vendors, interact with VCC’s latest teaching tools, and bid on a thrilling live auction hosted by Fred Lee.

Chef’s Experience: 6 – 9 p.m.

Watch the chefs at work and savor their food with one full hour of VIP entry featuring all 15 tasting stations, additional canapés, entry in the Chef’s Experience draw, and a take-home gift before continuing your evening at Flourish.

New alumni chefs at Flourish this year:

Chef Bo and Chef Thanya from RongSi Thai Bar & Bistro and Siam le Bien
Chef Connor & Chef Victoria from June on Cambie


All funds raised will help get students into the new Centre for Clean Energy and Automotive Innovation.

Attire: Wear a flourish of VCC green!

If you are unable to attend, please consider making a donation in lieu of a ticket.

Early bird pricing is on now. We hope you’ll join us!

Tickets on sale now
